comment: Plugins statically merged into librime for the XCFramework artifacts. The pinned revisions are the git submodule commits recorded in the repository index (.gitmodules); this manifest only describes how to build and verify each plugin. The build reads it to set RIME_PLUGINS, apply per-plugin patches, verify licenses, and report metadata.
